Hi all —

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical deep dive to walk through the proposed integration points and KV cache behavior with your architects. We want to make this hands-on: SE present, your architects for design questions, and an hour for a short proof-of-concept run.

Because the group spans US / EU / APAC, I sketched two overlap windows that should capture at least two regions simultaneously. Can you let me know which of the following (UTC) options work for you? If none work, please propose 2–3 slots that fit your local calendar.

Option A — early UTC window (works for US East + EU): 08:00–09:30 UTC (that is 04:00–05:30 PT, 09:00–10:30 UK, 10:00–11:30 CET)
Option B — late UTC window (works for EU + APAC): 15:00–16:30 UTC (11:00–12:30 PT, 16:00–17:30 UK, 17:00–18:30 CET, 00:00–01:30 JST next day)

A couple of notes: Marie, I remember France moves clocks the same week as UK this year — is CET/CEST causing trouble on your side? Kenta, I know late-evening sessions are tough; if APAC can only do a night slot we can also split into two half-sessions.

Attached: a short agenda and a quick overlap table I put together. I’ve also tentatively created a calendar stub (will confirm once we land on a slot).

Agenda highlights attached.

Best,
Olga
